title: Run one isolated signed GMGN cumulative holdings live smoke for one deterministic Solana input
objective: After an independent preflight audit is GREEN, manually execute exactly one read-only GMGN portfolio holdings request for exactly one deterministic Solana wallet selected in memory from the hash-verified Owner-approved external input. Validate both external input SHA-256 values before any network operation; select the first valid unique strict Base58 32-byte address according to this task's fixed rule; never print, persist or commit that address. Spawn only the pinned gmgn-cli 1.5.4 in a disposable CWD/HOME with GMGN_API_KEY and GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY supplied only from process environment, and force GMGN_RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_RETRY_MAX_WAIT_MS=0 so the single CLI invocation has an exact maximum of one physical provider request. Retain only a sanitized one-page normalized aggregate record or an allowlisted safe diagnostic code. This is a borrowed, unverified first-page holdings observation, not complete all-time wallet PnL or a chain-confirmed conclusion.
forbidden_actions: Do not call a chain other than Solana or a provider other than GMGN.

Do not make more than one GMGN CLI invocation or more than one physical provider request. Set GMGN_RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_RETRY_MAX_WAIT_MS=0 in the isolated child environment; do not retry, paginate, use a cursor, discover additional wallets, call another GMGN command, call Helius, or use any fallback provider.

Do not print, persist, commit or quote a wallet address, address label, API key, private key, credential-bearing URL, raw GMGN payload, raw stdout/stderr, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, token mint, token name, transaction signature, counterparty or per-token/per-trade record.

Do not read a credential from disk or ambient CLI configuration. Only inspect whether GMGN_API_KEY and GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY are present in process environment; do not display their values. If either is absent, PARK with an allowlisted safe code and make zero provider requests.
Do not write a database, Redis, cache, queue, scheduler, production system, transaction, signature, swap, order or trade.

Do not claim complete all-time wallet PnL, chain-confirmed realized profit, win rate, wallet quality, wallet classification, common ownership, clustering, address-library admission or Alpha N/R/SR/SSR/UR tier.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.

external_input_verification.selection_rule: Validate both hashes before any network operation. Parse sol_addresses.txt in file order. Normalize each line, retain only strict Base58 values decoding to exactly 32 bytes, deduplicate by first occurrence, and select exactly the first valid unique address in memory. Record only SHA-256('gmgn-signed-cumulative-holdings-live-smoke-001:' + selectedAddress) as a non-reversible target fingerprint.
